name: offhand
description: Offhand: touchless gesture viewer for 3D medical scans (HackPrinceton Fall 2026).

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @hoverscan/contracts build && HOVERSCAN_RUN=mock concurrently -k -n hub,web -c blue,magenta "pnpm --filter @offhand/hub dev" "pnpm --filter @offhand/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @hoverscan/contracts build && pnpm --filter @offhand/web build && pnpm --filter @offhand/hub build
scripts.check: pnpm --filter @hoverscan/contracts build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm --filter @hoverscan/contracts schema:check && pnpm --filter @offhand/hub test:failclosed
scripts.testpattern: uv run --project pipeline offhand-pipeline testpattern --out casepacks/test-pattern/tp-001
scripts.start:live: pnpm --filter @hoverscan/contracts build && pnpm --filter @offhand/web build && HOVERSCAN_RUN=live pnpm --filter @offhand/hub start:live
